sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Per-year trend of the average number of distinct research methods per publication
SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paperLabel) AS ?papers) (AVG(?methodCountRaw) AS ?avgMethodsPerPaper)
WHERE {
  # One row per paper with its year and the number of distinct methods it reports
  { SELECT ?paperLabel ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?methodLabel) AS ?methodCountRaw)
    WHERE {
      # Papers linked to a contribution of the Empirical Research Practice template
      ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
      ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
      ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
      # Publication year lives on the paper resource
      ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
      # Methods reported for data collection
      { ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m1 . ?m1 orkgp:P94003 ?mt1 . ?mt1 rdfs:label ?methodLabel . }
      UNION
      # Methods reported for data analysis
      { ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da orkgp:P1005 ?m2 . ?m2 orkgp:P94003 ?mt2 . ?mt2 rdfs:label ?methodLabel . }
      # Ignore placeholder method values
      FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodLabel)) != LCASE("no method"))
    }
    GROUP BY ?paperLabel ?year
  }
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year
# id: methods_per_paper_trend

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# One row per (paper, evaluation metric) pair so metrics can be ranked by frequency
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?metricLabel
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Evaluation node of the study
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_EVALUATION ?eval .
  # Metric used to evaluate the implemented approach
  ?eval orkgp:P110006 ?metric .
  ?metric rdfs:label ?metricLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: top_evaluation_metrics

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Papers that report an annotation scheme whose written guidelines are available
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?guidelineLabel
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Annotation process of the dataset
  ?contribution orkgp:P181031 ?annotationProcess .
  # Annotation scheme used
  ?annotationProcess orkgp:P181036 ?annotationScheme .
  # Availability of the written annotation guidelines
  ?annotationScheme orkgp:P181038 ?guidelineAvailability .
  ?guidelineAvailability rdfs:label ?guidelineLabel .
  # Keep only papers where guidelines exist in some form
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?guidelineLabel)) NOT IN ("no", "not reported"))
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: papers_with_annotation_guidelines

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Distribution of input abstraction levels and how each pairs with the RE task
SELECT DISTINCT ?paperLabel ?abstractionLabel ?reTaskLabel
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Dataset used by the study
  ?contribution orkgp:P181011 ?dataset .
  # Level of abstraction of the input data
  ?dataset orkgp:P181021 ?abstractionLevel .
  ?abstractionLevel rdfs:label ?abstractionLabel .
  # Requirements engineering task addressed by the same study
  OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P181002 ?reTask . ?reTask rdfs:label ?reTaskLabel . }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: abstraction_level_vs_re_task

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Types of baselines used in the evaluations, one row per paper-baseline-type pair
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?baselineTypeLabel
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Evaluation of the implemented approach
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_EVALUATION ?evaluation .
  # Baseline compared against
  ?evaluation orkgp:P181051 ?baseline .
  # Type of that baseline
  ?baseline orkgp:P181052 ?baselineType .
  ?baselineType rdfs:label ?baselineTypeLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: baseline_types

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Format of the textual requirements used as input, per paper, for frequency ranking
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?formatLabel
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # NLP dataset used by the study
  ?contribution orkgp:P181011 ?dataset .
  # Type of the data
  ?dataset orkgp:P181022 ?dataType .
  # Format of the data (e.g. "Shall" requirements, user stories, use cases)
  ?dataType orkgp:P181023 ?dataFormat .
  ?dataFormat rdfs:label ?formatLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: textual_requirement_formats

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# State of practice for validating the quality of annotated datasets
SELECT DISTINCT ?paperLabel ?agreementLabel ?metricLabel ?measured ?conflictLabel
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Annotation process of the dataset
  ?contribution orkgp:P181031 ?annotationProcess .
  # Annotator agreement node describing dataset quality validation
  ?annotationProcess orkgp:P181041 ?agreement .
  ?agreement rdfs:label ?agreementLabel .
  # Intercoder reliability metric used
  OPTIONAL { ?agreement orkgp:P181042 ?metric . ?metric rdfs:label ?metricLabel . }
  # Reported agreement value
  OPTIONAL { ?agreement orkgp:P181045 ?measured . }
  # How annotation conflicts were resolved
  OPTIONAL { ?agreement orkgp:P181044 ?conflict . ?conflict rdfs:label ?conflictLabel . }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: dataset_quality_validation

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Inventory of datasets available for each NLP4RE task type
SELECT DISTINCT ?paperLabel ?nlpTaskTypeLabel ?dataset ?formatLabel ?sourceTypeLabel ?items
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # NLP task of the study and its type
  ?contribution orkgp:P181003 ?nlpTask .
  ?nlpTask orkgp:P181004 ?taskType .
  ?taskType rdfs:label ?nlpTaskTypeLabel .
  # Dataset used for that task
  ?contribution orkgp:P181011 ?dataset .
  # Number of data items processed
  OPTIONAL { ?dataset orkgp:P181015 ?items . }
  # Format of the data
  OPTIONAL { ?dataset orkgp:P181022 ?dataType . ?dataType orkgp:P181023 ?dataFormat . ?dataFormat rdfs:label ?formatLabel . }
  # Source type of the data
  OPTIONAL { ?dataset orkgp:P181017 ?dataSource . ?dataSource orkgp:P181018 ?sourceType . ?sourceType rdfs:label ?sourceTypeLabel . }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: datasets_by_nlp_task

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Frequency of each (RE task, NLP task type) combination across papers
SELECT ?reTaskLabel ?nlpTaskTypeLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?papers)
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  # Requirements engineering task addressed
  ?contribution orkgp:P181002 ?reTask .
  ?reTask rdfs:label ?reTaskLabel .
  # NLP task and its type
  ?contribution orkgp:P181003 ?nlpTask .
  ?nlpTask orkgp:P181004 ?taskType .
  ?taskType rdfs:label ?nlpTaskTypeLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?reTaskLabel ?nlpTaskTypeLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?papers)
# id: re_nlp_combinations

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Sections/properties whose answers are highly heterogeneous free text, i.e. the
# ID Card offered too few predefined options and respondents answered "other"
SELECT ?sectionLabel ?propertyLabel
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?valueLabel) AS ?distinctAnswers)
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?papers)
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?longFreeTextAnswer) AS ?freeTextAnswers)
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  # Top-level ID Card section of the contribution
  ?contribution ?section ?sectionNode .
  ?section rdfs:label ?sectionLabel .
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?section), "http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/"))
  # Property answered inside that section
  ?sectionNode ?property ?value .
  ?property rdfs:label ?propertyLabel .
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?property), "http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/"))
  # Recorded answer
  ?value rdfs:label ?valueLabel .
  # Flag long free-text answers, a symptom of missing answer options
  BIND(IF(STRLEN(STR(?valueLabel)) > 60, ?valueLabel, ?unboundPlaceholder) AS ?longFreeTextAnswer)
}
GROUP BY ?sectionLabel ?propertyLabel
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?valueLabel) >= 6)
ORDER BY DESC(?distinctAnswers)
# id: sections_with_insufficient_options

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Distribution of the number of annotators per NLP task type
SELECT ?nlpTaskTypeLabel ?annotatorCount (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?papers)
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an NLP4RE ID Card contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  # NLP task and its type
  ?contribution orkgp:P181003 ?nlpTask .
  ?nlpTask orkgp:P181004 ?taskType .
  ?taskType rdfs:label ?nlpTaskTypeLabel .
  # Annotation process of the dataset
  ?contribution orkgp:P181031 ?annotationProcess .
  # Annotator node of that annotation process
  ?annotationProcess orkgp:P181032 ?annotator .
  # Number of annotators involved
  ?annotator orkgp:P59120 ?annotators .
  ?annotators rdfs:label ?annotatorCount .
}
GROUP BY ?nlpTaskTypeLabel ?annotatorCount
ORDER BY ?nlpTaskTypeLabel DESC(?papers)
# id: annotators_per_nlp_task

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# One row per (paper, psychological construct) pair so constructs can be ranked
# by the number of papers that investigate them
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?constructLabel
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to a Psychology Constructs and Measurements contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C115015 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Psychological construct investigated in the study
  ?contribution orkgp:P175094 ?construct .
  ?construct rdfs:label ?constructLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: constructs_investigated

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Which instruments/measures are used to operationalise impulsivity-related constructs
SELECT DISTINCT ?paperLabel ?constructLabel ?measureLabel
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to a Psychology Constructs and Measurements contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C115015 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Psychological construct investigated
  ?contribution orkgp:P175094 ?construct .
  ?construct rdfs:label ?constructLabel .
  # Restrict to impulsivity and its variants (trait, choice, behavioural ...)
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?constructLabel)), "impulsiv"))
  # Measurement instrument used for that construct
  ?contribution orkgp:P175095 ?measurement .
  ?measurement rdfs:label ?measureLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: impulsivity_measurements

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Number of distinct psychological constructs investigated by each paper
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?constructLabel) AS ?constructCount)
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to a Psychology Constructs and Measurements contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C115015 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Each distinct psychological construct reported for the contribution
  ?contribution orkgp:P175094 ?construct .
  ?construct rdfs:label ?constructLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?paper ?paperLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?constructCount)
# id: constructs_per_paper

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# One row per (paper, research approach, organization scale) so approaches such as
# observational or experimental can be ranked by the number of studies using them
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?approachLabel ?scaleLabel
WHERE {
  # Papers linked to an Ecology & Evolution study contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Research approach adopted by the study
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?approach .
  ?approach rdfs:label ?approachLabel .
  # Ecological organizational scale at which the approach is applied
  OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P115002 ?scale . ?scale rdfs:label ?scaleLabel . }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
# id: research_approaches
